finding: Homepage canonical pointed to the legacy gameforcast.top domain.
impact: Search engines could consolidate ranking signals to the wrong domain.
fix: Use self-referencing oneshowtools.com canonicals on the homepage and every public tool page.

finding: The original HTML exposed no product content without JavaScript.
evidence: parse_html reported word_count=4 with no H1, headings, images, or internal links.
impact: Non-JavaScript search and AI crawlers could not understand the platform or discover tools.
fix: Render meaningful static SEO content and page metadata in the server response.

evidence: parse_html returned an empty schema array.
impact: Search and answer engines lacked explicit organization, application, and page relationships.
fix: Add JSON-LD Organization, WebSite, CollectionPage, WebApplication, WebPage, and BreadcrumbList data.

finding: llms.txt was a false-positive SPA fallback with no machine-readable guidance.
evidence: llms checker found no title, description, sections, or links and scored it 5/100.
impact: AI systems had no reliable index of tools or authority pages.
fix: Publish valid llms.txt and llms-full.txt files with public tool links and key facts.

evidence: Google PageSpeed API rate-limited all bounded attempts.
impact: LCP, INP, or CLS issues may still affect mobile ranking and conversion.
fix: Measure with Search Console CrUX data after deployment.
